extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: crawler excavator (approx. 20 t class), approx. 8.4 x 2.9 x 3.7 m (L x W x H) in this pose, track length 3.9 m
extras.notes: front (boom) faces -Y; 'excavator_upper' (house, cab, counterweight) is a separate object with its origin in the slewing ring (rotate around local Z); 'excavator_boom', 'excavator_arm' and 'excavator_bucket' are separate objects with their origins on the joint pins (rotate around local X; a negative angle raises the boom); boom, arm, bucket and the cab windows are children of the upper structure (flat hierarchy: boom, arm and bucket do not follow each other); hydraulic cylinders are split: barrel on the carrying part, rod on the moving part; tracks are static; opaque tinted windows, no interior; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
